ZHasCompetitor_KUT.description: Boolean — true if a competitor has been logged against this opportunity

ProbabilityPercent.note: At TSS, opportunities above 85% are considered near-certain. Below 20% are considered at risk.

ExpectedRevenueAmount.description: Expected deal value in the opportunity currency
ExpectedRevenueAmount.note: Currency varies by sales org. Always check ExpectedRevenueAmountCurrencyCode.

ExpectedProcessingEndDate.description: Expected SOP (Start of Production) or deal close date — when revenue is expected to begin
